messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Losartan is used alone or in combination with other medications to treat high blood pressure in adults and children at least 6 years old.
Losartan is also used to decrease the risk of stroke.
This use applies to people who have high blood pressure.
It also applies to people with a heart condition called left ventricular hypertrophy.
Left ventricular hypertrophy is the enlargement of the walls of the left side of the heart.
Losartan may not decrease the risk of stroke in African Americans who have these conditions.
Losartan is also used to treat kidney disease.
It is used in people who have type 2 diabetes.
It is used in people who have high blood pressure.
Type 2 diabetes is a condition in which the body does not use insulin normally.
Therefore, people with type 2 diabetes cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood.
Losartan belongs to a class of medications called angiotensin II receptor antagonists.
It works by blocking the action of certain natural substances.
These substances tighten the blood vessels.
Blocking them allows the blood to flow more smoothly.

The relation 'may not reduce risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may not be effective in lowering the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be less effective in': The subject drug may not work as well in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
B. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
